description: Stage several operations that must land atomically (edits, new, moved or deleted files, symbol renames, code actions) and commit them only after the sandbox pipeline ran: action=prepare with operations inline, then action=apply with the returned plan_id, plan_revision and prepared_revision. kind=replace_matches replaces every hit of a search result set (target.handle is the set_ handle, content the replacement). Four kinds ask the language server what it would change and stage its answer as exact ranges: kind=rename_symbol (content is the new name), kind=apply_code_action (content is the action title from code_actions), kind=inline_symbol, and kind=safe_delete_symbol, which refuses and lists the call sites when anything outside the declaration still refers to it. For one edit use edit_apply instead: it is one call. response_mode=compact returns a concise receipt and optional diagnostics; evidence and refusal recovery remain available.

accept_provisional.description: With action=apply, commit a PROVISIONAL plan by explicitly accepting its incomplete diagnostic evidence.

operations.description: At most 8 operations per request. Build larger plans incrementally with action=edit and edit.mode=add.

content.description: Exact UTF-8 content for the declared operation (maximum 4 MiB).

destination_revision_id.description: Expected destination document revision for move_file and copy_file.

expected_sha256.description: copy_file: hash the source must have; bound at creation when omitted. The source may be an absolute path outside the workspace.

from.description: Source path for move_file or copy_file.

op_id.description: Stable operation identifier unique within the plan.

path.description: Workspace path for create_file or delete_file.

revision_id.description: Expected source/path document revision. Optional for create_file; Huyang binds the current missing-target revision..

after_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bounded following anchor.

before_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bounded preceding anchor.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact selected bytes.

name_path.description: Declaration name path: Name, Parent/Name, Parent.Name, Parent::Name or, for Go methods, (*Parent).Name; all are normalised to Parent/Name.

to.description: Destination path for move_file or copy_file.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key for safe retries; generated when omitted.

include_diagnostics.description: In compact mode include diagnostic bodies/notices; otherwise return their availability and verification status, with diagnostics as the follow-up.

invariants.description: What the result must satisfy, checked against the prepared revision before anything is applied. A required invariant that is violated or that nobody could evaluate keeps the plan out of READY and has no accept flag; an advisory one leaves the plan PROVISIONAL. Editing the plan drops every proof. api_compatible reads each affected file's exported surface before and after (Go and TypeScript); path_unreachable can refute reachability from one remaining reference but cannot yet prove it, so it answers violated or unknown.

id.description: Stable identifier, so the answer can be matched to the assertion. Assigned when omitted.

paths.description: Narrows a diagnostic assertion to these files; every staged file when omitted.

to.description: Destination path for move_file or copy_file.

plan_id.description: Required after creation unless prepare supplies operations inline.

response_format.description: both preserves text and structured payloads; text omits their duplicate structured copy; structured returns structured data with a short text receipt. Overrides the response_mode transport default.

response_mode.description: compact returns one text payload by default, concise edit receipts, and read source windows of 64 KiB unless max_bytes is supplied. full preserves the existing response. Refusal and verification information is retained.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID from workspace_open; or omit it and pass root.
